hypotheses.hypothesis: Killing the checkoutservice pod will cause the place order workflow to fail, as checkoutservice is the orchestrator for order placement.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: checkoutservice is a critical dependency in the order placement workflow; its absence breaks the business transaction.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: frontend HTTP 200 and successful order response with order_id and shipping_tracking_id
hypotheses.validation_plan: baseline, inject, observe, recover, cleanup, washout
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After pod restart, checkoutservice becomes available and order placement succeeds.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Killing the cartservice pod will cause the add item step to fail, preventing the order from being placed.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: cartservice is required for adding items to the cart; without it, the workflow cannot proceed.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: frontend HTTP 200 and successful order response with order_id and shipping_tracking_id
hypotheses.validation_plan: baseline, inject, observe, recover, cleanup, washout
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After pod restart, cartservice becomes available and add item succeeds.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Killing the frontend pod will cause the health check to fail, breaking the entire workflow.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: frontend is the entry point; its unavailability directly impacts the health check and user interactions.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: frontend HTTP 200 and successful order response with order_id and shipping_tracking_id
hypotheses.validation_plan: baseline, inject, observe, recover, cleanup, washout
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After pod restart, frontend becomes available and health check succeeds.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Killing the productcatalogservice pod will cause product listing to fail, preventing item selection and order placement.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: productcatalogservice provides product data; without it, the frontend cannot display products or add items.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: frontend HTTP 200 and successful order response with order_id and shipping_tracking_id
hypotheses.validation_plan: baseline, inject, observe, recover, cleanup, washout
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After pod restart, productcatalogservice becomes available and product listing works.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Introducing 500ms latency to checkoutservice will cause timeouts in the order placement, leading to workflow failure.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: checkoutservice is critical for order placement; increased latency may exceed client timeouts.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: frontend HTTP 200 and successful order response with order_id and shipping_tracking_id
hypotheses.validation_plan: baseline, inject, observe, recover, cleanup, washout
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After latency injection ends, checkoutservice responds normally and order placement succeeds.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Introducing 500ms latency to cartservice will cause add item to be slow, potentially timing out and failing the workflow.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: cartservice is used in the add item step; high latency may cause client timeouts.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: frontend HTTP 200 and successful order response with order_id and shipping_tracking_id
hypotheses.validation_plan: baseline, inject, observe, recover, cleanup, washout
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After latency injection ends, cartservice responds normally and add item succeeds.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Introducing 50% packet loss to checkoutservice will cause intermittent failures in order placement, likely breaking the workflow.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: checkoutservice is critical; packet loss may cause request failures or retries that exceed timeouts.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: frontend HTTP 200 and successful order response with order_id and shipping_tracking_id
hypotheses.validation_plan: baseline, inject, observe, recover, cleanup, washout
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After loss injection ends, checkoutservice becomes reliable and order placement succeeds.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Introducing 50% packet loss to cartservice will cause add item to fail intermittently, preventing order placement.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: cartservice is used in add item; packet loss may cause request failures.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: frontend HTTP 200 and successful order response with order_id and shipping_tracking_id
hypotheses.validation_plan: baseline, inject, observe, recover, cleanup, washout
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After loss injection ends, cartservice becomes reliable and add item succeeds.
